notes.title: Flash & Dash Update
notes.content: In the latest SpeedrunnerZ update, we're taking the sprinting experience to a whole new level! The revamped speedrunner stopwatch now starts as soon as the game begins and keeps a continuous track of your time across all levels, allowing you to race against your personal bests. Enhanced parallax effects bring new depth and dynamism to the maps, while improved lighting breathes life into every corner of the course. Get ready to push your limits and chase those record-breaking times with a fully immersive visual upgrade!
